> I read this as codebase search - locate the canonical local Orca desktop UI/source repo under local development locations, inspect its framework/build system, key shell/layout/state files, and determine how Orca Lite can reuse or reference it.

<analysis>
**Literal Request**: Locate the canonical local Orca desktop UI/source repository on the workstation, identify its framework, build system, and key shell/layout/state files, and assess whether it can be reused directly or referenced.
**Actual Need**: Give the developer the exact local source directory and architecture breakdown of the original/canonical Orca desktop UI so Orca Lite can accurately mirror its UI patterns, layout, state, and component structure without guesswork.
**Success Looks Like**: Absolute path to the canonical Orca source repo verified as real source (package.json, src tree, configs), breakdown of framework/build system, list of key UI shell/layout/state files, and an architectural reuse vs reference assessment.
</analysis>

<answer>
1. Canonical Source Location:
- The canonical Orca desktop application is present locally at `/Applications/Orca.app` (Bundle ID: `com.stablyai.orca`, Version: `1.4.184`, Build ID: `1.4.184-17ef6ccce68089e0878cf1d26b7502bfccbb787f-arm64`, Upstream repo: `stablyai/orca`).
- The unbundled source code repository (raw TypeScript/React source for original Orca) is not present as a separate Git clone on this machine. Instead, the canonical desktop UI has been extracted directly from `/Applications/Orca.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar` into `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/original-dist/`.

2. Framework & Build System:
- Original Orca App: Electron + Node.js runtime + React/Vite web bundle.
- Orca Lite: Rust (Tauri v2) backend (`/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri`) with React 18 + Vite 6 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 3 frontend (`/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui`), using `@xterm/xterm` (v6) with WebGL acceleration for terminal rendering.

3. Key Shell, Layout, and State Files in Orca Lite:
- Shell / Root: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/App.tsx`
- Layout / Panes: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/Sidebar.tsx`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/WorkspaceHeader.tsx`
- State Management: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/state/layout.ts`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/state/workspaceRuntime.ts`
- IPC & Event Streaming: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/tauri.ts`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/terminalEvents.ts`

4. Reuse vs. Reference Assessment:
- Direct Code Reuse: Infeasible for backend and application shell because the original is a closed, compiled Electron application (`app.asar`) coupled to Node.js/Electron APIs and a heavy background daemon protocol (v33).
- Static Asset Reuse: Direct reuse is feasible and already active for static assets such as fonts (`Geist-Variable.woff2`), Orca SVG/PNG branding assets, and icons located in `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/original-dist/assets/`.
- Architectural Reference: Highly valuable. Orca Lite references the visual hierarchy, component breakdown (Sidebar, Active Agents card list, Worktree treeview, Split Terminal, Header), and color palette from `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/original-dist/` while implementing clean, idiomatic React + Tauri v2 components with strict 1-PTY-per-tab and 1-Writer-per-worktree invariants.
</answer>

<next_steps>
Ready to proceed - no follow-up needed. Use `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/` for active development and `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/original-dist/` as the visual and asset reference for Orca desktop fidelity.
</next_steps>

> I read this as codebase search - perform a deep design-system audit on the extracted canonical Orca renderer assets to determine styling methodology, tokens, typography, primitives, layout architecture, and Tauri portability.

<analysis>
**Literal Request**: Audit the extracted canonical Orca renderer assets (`ui/original-dist/`) for styling methodology, theme tokens/dark mode, typography/fonts, spacing/radii/shadows/motion, component primitive libraries, pane/resize layout architecture, and Electron vs Tauri portability with exact cited evidence.
**Actual Need**: Produce a rigorous, evidence-backed design system specification so the Orca Lite UI replacement can precisely match canonical Orca desktop fidelity (tokens, font pairings, radix/tailwind primitives, split layouts) while safely stripping Electron coupling.
**Success Looks Like**: A comprehensive, evidence-cited audit reporting exact files, CSS classes, CSS variable declarations, imported primitives, font families, and portability boundaries with clear separation between proven facts and inferences.
</analysis>

<results>
<files>
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/original-dist/assets/I18nProvider-TFirEJhb.css - Master CSS stylesheet containing design tokens, CSS variables, dark/light theme definitions, font faces, and animation keyframes
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/original-dist/assets/document-theme-66WaD9Gm.js - Theme switching logic (`resolveDocumentTheme`, `applyDocumentTheme`, `.dark` / `.light` root classes, `theme-transition-disabled`)

- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/original-dist/assets/context-menu-D4RKI7hR.js - Radix UI ContextMenu implementation with frosted glass styling
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/original-dist/assets/hover-card-DP92-D-b.js - Radix UI HoverCard component and surface styling
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/original-dist/assets/tooltip-DPmd1AoJ.js - Radix UI Tooltip implementation

<answer>
### 1. Styling Methodology
- **Observed Proof**:
  - Utility-first **Tailwind CSS** compiled with Tailwind v3/v4 utility classes (e.g., `z-[70]`, `backdrop-blur-2xl`, `outline-hidden`, `origin-(--radix-popover-transform-origin)`, `max-h-(--radix-popover-content-available-height)` in `dropdown-menu-Dth6LPK-.js` and `I18nProvider-TFirEJhb.css`).
  - **CSS Custom Properties (Design Tokens)**: Master theme variables declared in `:root` and `.dark` blocks in `I18nProvider-TFirEJhb.css:24177-24430`.
  - **Class Name Composition**: Standard `clsx`/`tailwind-merge` utility pattern (`cn(...)`) used throughout components for dynamic class merging.
  - **Component-Scoped CSS**: Dedicated CSS sheets for specialized sub-systems (e.g., `editor-B6UfNlAV.css`, `monaco-setup-BDOssqxQ.css`, `xterm-DlV7Zldf.css`, `AgentKanbanBoard-Zne6tHpl.css`).

### 2. Theme & Token Definitions (Light & Dark Mode)
- **Dark Mode Mechanism (Proof in `document-theme-66WaD9Gm.js`)**:
  - Toggled via `.dark` / `.light` class on `document.documentElement`.
  - During theme switches, `.theme-transition-disabled` is added to `:root` across two `requestAnimationFrame` ticks to prevent CSS transition flash.
  - Supports explicit `"dark"`, `"light"`, or system preference (`(prefers-color-scheme: dark)`).
- **Exact Token Values (Proof in `I18nProvider-TFirEJhb.css:24177-24430`)**:
  - **Dark Mode (`.dark`)**:
    - `--background`: `#0a0a0a` (Near pure black zinc)
    - `--foreground`: `#fafafa`
    - `--card`: `#171717` (Zinc 900) / `--card-foreground`: `#fafafa`
    - `--popover`: `#171717` / `--popover-foreground`: `#fafafa`
    - `--primary`: `#e5e5e5` (Zinc 200) / `--primary-foreground`: `#171717`
    - `--secondary`: `#262626` (Zinc 800) / `--secondary-foreground`: `#fafafa`
    - `--muted`: `#262626` / `--muted-foreground`: `#a1a1a1` (Zinc 400)
    - `--accent`: `#404040` (Zinc 700) / `--accent-foreground`: `#fafafa`
    - `--destructive`: `#ff6568` / `--destructive-foreground`: `#df2225`
    - `--border`: `#ffffff12` (7% white overlay)
    - `--input`: `#ffffff26` (15% white overlay)
    - `--ring`: `#737373`
    - `--worktree-sidebar`: `#2a2a2a` / `--worktree-sidebar-accent`: `#353535`
    - `--sidebar`: `#171717` / `--sidebar-accent`: `#262626`
    - `--status-success`: `#86efac`
    - `--ai-action-accent`: `var(--color-violet-400)`
    - `--terminal-pane-locate`: `var(--color-blue-400)`
  - **Light Mode (`:root`)**:
    - `--background`: `#ffffff` / `--foreground`: `#0a0a0a`
    - `--card`: `#ffffff` / `--card-foreground`: `#0a0a0a`
    - `--primary`: `#171717` / `--primary-foreground`: `#fafafa`
    - `--secondary`: `#f5f5f5` / `--muted`: `#f5f5f5` / `--muted-foreground`: `#737373`
    - `--border`: `#e5e5e5` / `--input`: `#e5e5e5`
    - `--worktree-sidebar`: `#f5f5f5` / `--worktree-sidebar-accent`: `#eaeaea`

### 3. Typography & Font Stacks
- **Proof in `I18nProvider-TFirEJhb.css:24155-24176`**:
  - **UI Sans**: `Geist` variable font (`src: url("./Geist-Variable-CrgPqtmy.woff2")`, `font-weight: 100 900; font-display: swap`).
    - CSS variable: `--font-sans: var(--app-font-family);` where `--app-font-family: "Geist", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;`
  - **Monospace**: `"SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace`.
    - CSS variable: `--font-mono`.
  - **Symbol Font**: `Orca Nerd Font Symbols` (`./SymbolsNerdFontMono-Regular-CoUzE12l.woff2`, `unicode-range: U+E000-F8FF, U+F0000-FFFFD, U+100000-10FFFD; font-display: swap`).

### 4. Spacing, Radius, Borders, Shadows & Motion Conventions
- **Border Radii (Proof in `I18nProvider-TFirEJhb.css` & component JS)**:
  - Base token: `--radius: .625rem` (10px).
  - Popovers / Dropdowns / Dialogs: `rounded-[11px]`.
  - Buttons / Inputs / Cards: `rounded-md` (6px) or `rounded-lg` (8px).
  - Badges / Status Pills: `rounded-full`.
- **Surfaces & Glassmorphism (Proof in `dropdown-menu-Dth6LPK-.js` & `context-menu-D4RKI7hR.js`)**:
  - Popovers / Context Menus use translucent frosted glass:
    - Dark: `bg-[rgba(0,0,0,0.72)] border border-white/14 backdrop-blur-2xl shadow-[0_20px_44px_rgba(0,0,0,0.42),inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.04)]`
    - Light: `bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.82)] border border-black/14 backdrop-blur-2xl shadow-[0_16px_36px_rgba(0,0,0,0.24),inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.14)]`
- **Animations & Keyframes (Proof in `I18nProvider-TFirEJhb.css:26180-28190`)**:
  - Dialog / Tooltip / Popover transitions: `animate-in fade-in-0 zoom-in-95 data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2` with `origin-(--radix-popper-transform-origin)`.
  - Collapsible accordions: `@keyframes collapsible-down { from { height: 0 } to { height: var(--radix-collapsible-content-height) } }`.
  - Agent spinner: `@keyframes agent-spinner-rotate`.

### 5. Component Primitives & Libraries
- **Proof in `index.html` modulepreloads and chunk analysis**:
  - **Radix UI Headless Primitives**: `@radix-ui/react-popover`, `@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu`, `@radix-ui/react-context-menu`, `@radix-ui/react-select`, `@radix-ui/react-tooltip`, `@radix-ui/react-dialog`, `@radix-ui/react-scroll-area`, `@radix-ui/react-tabs`, `@radix-ui/react-toggle-group`, `@radix-ui/react-switch`, `@radix-ui/react-collapsible`, `@radix-ui/react-hover-card`.
  - **Icons**: `lucide-react` (v0.577.0 confirmed in `button-DszXJEV6.js:5-10`).
  - **Toasts**: `Sonner` (`[data-sonner-toaster]` in `dist-DgqligFk.js:345`).
  - **Code Editor**: `Monaco Editor` (`monaco-editor` with custom tokenizers).
  - **Terminal**: `@xterm/xterm` with FitAddon & WebGL addon.

### 6. Resize, Layout & Pane Architecture
- **Sidebar & Resizable Dividers (Proof in `useSidebarResize-BhlGhEjK.js`)**:
  - Custom React hook `useSidebarResize({ isOpen, width, minWidth, maxWidth, deltaSign, setWidth, onDraftWidthChange })`.
  - Driven by `window.addEventListener("mousemove")` and `"mouseup"` with `window.requestAnimationFrame` throttling.
  - Inserts a full-window transparent drag overlay (`removeDragOverlay`) during active resizing to prevent iframes/terminals from intercepting pointer capture.
  - Updates container inline width dynamically during drag, persisting only on mouse up.
- **Terminal Split Pane Layout (Proof in `Terminal-qm6WvB4Q.js` and `I18nProvider-TFirEJhb.css:21680-21940`)**:
  - Terminal pane title bar fixed height: `--orca-pane-title-height: 24px`.
  - Dynamic overlay tooltip height: `--orca-terminal-link-tooltip-height: 25px`.
  - Divider color variables: `--orca-terminal-divider-color: #3f3f46` (dark) and strong divider `#71717a`.
  - CSS Anchor Positioning probe: `--orca-terminal-overlay-probe` used when browser supports `position-anchor`.

### 7. Tauri Portability vs Electron Coupling
- **Tauri-Portable (Safe to Reuse / Direct Target)**:
  - Full Tailwind design token dictionary (`--background`, `--foreground`, `--card`, `--border`, `--worktree-sidebar`, etc.).
  - Geist font face and Nerd Font symbol mappings.
  - Radix UI component library stack and Radix Popper animation presets (`data-[side]`, `zoom-in-95`).
  - `useSidebarResize` drag-handling pattern (pure DOM/React event loop).
  - Terminal visual hierarchy, tab styling, and split view containers.
- **Electron-Coupled (Must Be Replaced by Tauri v2 Commands / Events)**:
  - `window.api.ui.syncTrafficLights` / `setZoomLevel` -> Tauri native macOS window decoration & `tauri-plugin-window-state`.
  - `window.api.ui.writeClipboardText` / `writeClipboardImage` -> `@tauri-apps/plugin-clipboard-manager`.
  - `window.api.shell.openUrl` / `openPath` -> `@tauri-apps/plugin-opener` or `tauri::ipc`.
  - `window.api.pty.*` -> Orca Lite's `portable-pty` Tokio channels (`create_terminal_session`, `write_terminal_input`, `terminal_output` event).
  - `window.api.browser.*` (embedded Electron webview / grab mode) -> Out of scope / pure web links in Tauri.
</answer>

<next_steps>
Ready to proceed - no follow-up needed. The design system audit establishes the exact specification (Geist font, zinc dark tokens, Radix UI component structure, 11px popover radii, and RAF-based resize architecture) for Orca Lite's UI replacement.
</next_steps>
</results>
